title: Information processing method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an information processing method, an information processing device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium; the related embodiments can be applied to various scenes such as cloud technology, artificial intelligence, intelligent transportation, auxiliary driving and the like. According to the method, after interaction information to be processed is obtained, interaction objects participating in interaction are extracted from the interaction information to be processed, after an interaction object set is obtained, target interaction information of each interaction object in the interaction object set is respectively screened out from a preset interaction information set, interaction characteristics of the interaction objects are extracted from the target interaction information, then the interaction characteristics are converted into time sequence characteristics, then the time sequence characteristics are fused to obtain target time sequence characteristics corresponding to the interaction information to be processed, and then target information of the interaction information to be processed is determined according to the target time sequence characteristics; the scheme can improve the accuracy of information processing.

title: Information display method, device and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides an information display method, information display equipment and a storage medium. In the information display method, when a first image area in the object distribution diagram is displayed, the first image area displayed in the interface can be updated to a second image area containing the selected object according to the position distribution data of the selected object in the position distribution diagram in response to the viewing operation of the selected object in at least one object contained in the object distribution diagram. Based on this, the content displayed by the interface can be quickly switched from the first image area to the second image area, which is beneficial to improving the efficiency of reviewing the selected object.

title: Artificial intelligence based monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring, and provides a monitoring system and a monitoring method based on artificial intelligence, wherein the monitoring system comprises a data acquisition unit; a data storage unit; the data processing unit is used for analyzing and processing the data through an artificial intelligence technology, acquiring image data, monitoring equipment data and shooting time data which are identified from a video, inputting multi-source information data into a machine learning model, and acquiring image data classified according to image types and/or image data classified according to monitoring equipment and/or image data ordered according to time sequence; the data matching unit is used for comparing the target image data with the label data obtained by the data processing unit, if the comparison is consistent, the matching is successful, and if the comparison is inconsistent, the matching is failed; and the data positioning unit is used for positioning all image data successfully matched in the data matching unit to acquire video data. The invention can save the time for the user to know the monitoring condition of the target area.

title: Equipment control method and electronic equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an equipment control method and electronic equipment, relates to the technical field of communication, and aims to solve the problems of high difficulty and low operation convenience when a user operates a household appliance according to a paper specification. The scheme comprises the following steps: identifying target equipment displayed in a shooting preview interface; in the shooting preview interface, operation guide information of the target device is displayed, and the operation guide information comprises at least one of the following items: an operation menu of the target device and an operation flow of the target device. The method is applied to a scene of controlling the equipment through the electronic equipment.

title: Vehicle abnormality detection method and system
abstract: The invention provides a vehicle abnormity detection system and method, which comprises an abnormity detection module: detecting the abnormal state of the vehicle through information monitoring of the vehicle equipment, judging whether the vehicle is abnormal or not, if so, stopping the vehicle running, and if not, continuously detecting the abnormality; a data acquisition module: and vehicle operation data are collected in real time and sent to the abnormality detection module. According to the invention, the abnormal state of the vehicle is detected by monitoring the information of the vehicle equipment, so that the running safety of the vehicle is improved; by using abnormal sound detection, false detection caused by data fluctuation of normal operation of the vehicle is prevented; by means of online vehicle operation, data acquisition is carried out, data are analyzed and learned, an abnormal detection method is improved, the accuracy of detection is improved, false detection is prevented, and the stability of vehicle operation is improved.

title: Purifying device for boiler waste gas treatment
abstract: The utility model discloses a purification device for boiler waste gas treatment, which comprises a first box body, wherein one side of the first box body is fixedly communicated with an air inlet pipe, one end of the first box body, which is positioned at the air inlet pipe, is fixedly communicated with a dust removing cloth bag, the top of the first box body is fixedly communicated with a connecting pipe, one end of the connecting pipe is fixedly communicated with a second box body, the top of the second box body is provided with a spraying assembly, the inner wall of the second box body is provided with a groove, the inside of the groove is detachably provided with a mounting plate, the inside of the mounting plate is provided with a filter screen, one side, which is positioned below the filter screen, of the second box body is fixedly communicated with a liquid inlet pipe, dust particles in the sprayed adsorption liquid are filtered through the filter screen, the adsorption liquid is recycled through a water pump, the adsorption capacity of the adsorption liquid is ensured, and the stability of the device is improved.

title: Waste gas treatment equipment with activated carbon adsorption device
abstract: The invention relates to the field of waste gas treatment, in particular to waste gas treatment equipment with an activated carbon adsorption device, which comprises a shell, a conveying pipeline, a one-way valve, a mounting plate, an adsorption cavity and a treatment cavity, wherein the adsorption cavity and the treatment cavity are arranged in the shell; when handling waste gas, drive assembly through the operation of drive reciprocating mechanism and then drive the slider reciprocal slip in the admission line, and then with waste gas ration inhale behind the admission line rethread pipeline enter into and adsorb the chamber, install and to adsorb some dust particles in the chamber can with waste gas get rid of filtering piece, the setting is after the preliminary treatment is done to waste gas to the active carbon in the absorption chamber, gas passes through the pipe and enters into the treatment cavity, the treatment fluid in the treatment cavity can get rid of harmful gas, promote the quality to exhaust-gas treatment.

title: Sludge dewatering device for environmental protection
abstract: The utility model discloses a sludge dewatering device for environmental protection, including the dewatering box, the bottom fixedly connected with base of dewatering box, the right side fixedly connected with cylinder at dewatering box inner chamber top, the bottom fixedly connected with clamp plate of cylinder, the inner chamber cover of clamp plate is equipped with the fixed column, the top fixedly connected with connecting axle of fixed column, the helicla flute has been seted up on the surface of connecting axle, and the inner chamber swing joint of helicla flute has the connecting rod, the bottom and the clamp plate fixed connection of connecting rod, the bottom fixedly connected with scraper blade of spliced pole. The utility model discloses a cooperation of dewatering box, cylinder, clamp plate, fixed column, connecting axle, connecting rod, scraper blade, base, filter plate, water guide plate, pivot, eccentric wheel, stopper, spliced pole, riser and spring has solved the easy jam of current dewatering device not only filter screen, and inconvenient change the filter screen moreover, the inconvenient problem of using.

title: Waste gas purification recovery processing device for feed processing
abstract: The utility model discloses a waste gas purification and recovery treatment device for feed processing, which comprises a support ring and a drying box body, wherein a partition plate is fixedly arranged in the drying box body, slide bars are fixedly connected to the outer side of the upper surface of the partition plate in an annular array manner, a first rotary drum is movably arranged in the drying box body above the slide bars, the top end of the first rotary drum is rotatably arranged with a second rotary drum, the top end of the second rotary drum is rotatably arranged with a third rotary drum, the upper part of the outer wall of the third rotary drum is slidably connected with the inner wall of the support ring, a filter screen module is movably arranged on the upper surface of the support ring, a drying box cover body is movably arranged at the top end of the drying box body, an access cover is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the drying box body, and a reserved hole is formed in the front surface of the access cover. The utility model solves the problems of low heat energy conversion efficiency and air pollution.

title: Energy-concerving and environment-protective exhaust treatment device
abstract: The utility model relates to a waste gas treatment technical field, concretely relates to energy-concerving and environment-protective exhaust treatment device, the load simulator comprises a device body, cover and filter screen breathe in, still include the clearance subassembly, the clearance subassembly includes the supporting seat, spacing, limit slide, the threaded rod, the connecting plate, the scraper blade, clean brush and drive component, supporting seat and device body fixed connection, spacing and supporting seat fixed connection, limit slide and spacing sliding connection, the threaded rod passes through drive component with the device body and is connected, and with limit slide threaded connection, connecting plate and limit slide fixed connection, scraper blade and connecting plate fixed connection, clean brush and connecting plate fixed connection, drive component sets up on the device body, can avoid filter screen long-term back greasy dirt cooperation large granule material of using through scraper blade and clean brush, the piece is blockked up to the floater.

title: Clamping conveying device for machining
abstract: The application discloses a clamping and conveying device for machining, which relates to the field of clamping and conveying equipment and comprises a machining table, wherein two clamping rails are arranged above the machining table in parallel, first driving mechanisms for driving the two clamping rails to perform centering or separating movement are arranged on two sides of the clamping rails, elastic clamping assemblies for clamping workpieces are arranged on adjacent sides of the two clamping rails, lifting pieces for driving the first driving mechanisms to lift are arranged on two sides of the machining table, and a second driving mechanism for driving the elastic clamping assemblies to move with the workpieces is arranged on one side of the machining table. The application not only can carry out self-adaptive adjustment according to the small size difference of the same workpiece and stably clamp the workpiece, but also can adjust the clamping distance according to different types of workpieces, and has strong adaptability.

title: Press mounting device with automatic feeding and discharging function
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of press-fitting devices, and discloses a press-fitting device with automatic feeding and discharging, which comprises a press-fitting device and a material taking device, wherein the material taking device is arranged at the front side of the top end of the press-fitting device, the press-fitting device comprises a placing plate, the top end of the placing plate is fixedly connected with a supporting plate at the rear side, the top end of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a top plate, the top end of the placing plate is fixedly connected with a working shell at the rear side, two sides of the bottom end of the inner side wall of the working shell are respectively fixedly connected with a second telescopic rod, the top end of the working shell is fixedly connected with the press-fitting shell, and two sides of the bottom end of the inner side wall of the press-fitting shell are respectively provided with a top block. According to the utility model, the press-fitting device with automatic feeding and discharging functions is provided, the workpiece can be effectively ejected out by means of the second telescopic rod, and the workpiece can be effectively taken out by means of the material taking device and discharged by the conveyor belt.

title: 90-degree double-cylinder sleeve taking and placing device
abstract: The utility model discloses a 90-degree double-cylinder sleeve taking and placing device, which comprises a mounting seat; the rotating assembly is arranged on the mounting seat; the first cylinder sleeve grabbing assembly is arranged on the mounting seat; the second cylinder sleeve grabbing component is arranged on the rotating component and rotates along with the control of the rotating component; the first rotating angle control assembly is arranged on the mounting seat and used for limiting the rotation of the second cylinder sleeve grabbing assembly; and the second rotating angle control assembly is arranged on the mounting seat and is used for limiting the rotation of the second cylinder sleeve grabbing assembly. The utility model discloses can combine control system to realize automatic pack into 2 cylinder liners die casting machine's mould in, improve production efficiency, reduce personal safety hidden danger.

title: Plate shearing machine for plate processing
abstract: The utility model discloses a plate shearing machine for plate processing, which comprises an installation support, a conveying mechanism, a plate cutting mechanism and a driving mechanism, wherein the installation support is fixedly arranged on the plate shearing machine; the conveying mechanism, the plate cutting mechanism and the driving mechanism are all arranged on the mounting bracket; the plate cutting mechanism comprises a plate pressing mechanism, a cutter frame and a connecting plate; the cutter comprises a first cutter and a second cutter; the pressing plate mechanism comprises a connecting bolt, a pressing plate body and a spring; still be provided with the mounting hole on the connecting plate, connecting bolt passes the mounting hole and extends to the below of first cutter, and connecting bolt is provided with the spring with this body coupling of clamp plate in connecting bolt's the outside. Drive the cut trigger through actuating mechanism and reciprocate to the clamp plate body can also reciprocate along with the cut trigger, accomplishes reciprocal extrusion fixed to panel, does not accomplish the fixed to panel at needs manual work, has improved the cutting efficiency of panel, has reduced intensity of labour, has improved the practicality of device.

title: Cutting device for processing light guide plate
abstract: The utility model discloses a cutting device for processing a light guide plate, which comprises a box body, a workbench and a vertical plate; the conveying device is arranged, the light guide plate does not need to be moved manually, the workload can be reduced, and the conveying device is safe, convenient and quick and is provided with the accommodating groove, so that waste materials can be recycled; the screw rod is high in movement precision and low in energy consumption, and the sliding block and the clamping plate are arranged on the screw rod, so that the light guide plate can be clamped and cut better, and the cutting quality and the working efficiency are improved; cutting blade and cutting head can be changed at any time, and the cutting head is rotatable, makes cutting accuracy higher, has improved the cutting quality.

title: Display device
abstract: The invention discloses a display device, which comprises a first substrate, at least one active element arranged on the first substrate, a dielectric layer arranged on the at least one active element, at least one pixel electrode electrically connected with the at least one active element, a second substrate arranged opposite to the first substrate, a first spacer arranged on the second substrate and a display medium. The dielectric layer has a first protrusion and a body portion outside the first protrusion. At least one pixel electrode is disposed on the main body portion of the dielectric layer. The vertical projection of the first protrusion of the dielectric layer on the first substrate is located within the vertical projection of the first spacer on the first substrate.

title: Photodetector and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: The present invention provides a method for manufacturing a photodetector, including obtaining a substrate; filling argon at a first flow rate and oxygen at a second flow rate into a processing machine, depositing an active layer onto the substrate by sputtering, filling argon at a third flow rate into the processing machine, and depositing an electrode layer onto the active layer by sputtering. The method provided in this disclosure allows for a more stable deposition of zinc oxide on the substrate by controlling the flow rates of argon and oxygen which flow into the process machine. Such that, there is no need for an additional buffer layer between the active and electrode layers, thereby enhancing manufacturing efficiency and reducing production costs.

title: Electronic device and formation method therefor
abstract: An electronic device and a method of forming the same are disclosed. An emitter resonator and a reception cap cavity are formed on and in a first wafer, and an emitter cap cavity and a reception resonator are formed in and on a second wafer. After bonding together the first and second wafers, an emitter filter is formed in an emission region, and a reception filter is formed in a receiving region. The method provided in the present invention not only can simplify the fabrication process of the device and improve its accuracy and stability, but also facilitates integration of the emitter and receives filters in a same chip, which results in a higher degree of integration of the device and a more compact package size thereof.

title: Display panel, display apparatus, and preparation method for display panel
abstract: The present application discloses a display panel, a display apparatus, and a preparation method for a display panel. The display panel includes a substrate, an isolation structure, a light-emitting layer, and a first encapsulation layer. The first encapsulation layer includes encapsulation portions configured to encapsulate light-emitting units. Orthogonal projections of adjacent encapsulation portions on the substrate overlap to form overlapping regions. The overlapping regions include a first region and a second region, and a width of the first region is different from a width of the second region, for example, the second region has a larger width, that is, adjacent encapsulation portions have a larger overlapping width in the second region.

title: Display device and method for fabrication thereof
abstract: A display device is provided. The display device comprises: a plurality of pixel electrodes arranged to be spaced apart from each other on a first substrate; a first light emitting element disposed on one pixel electrode of the plurality of pixel electrodes; a common substrate disposed on the first light emitting element and including a hole; and a second light emitting element disposed in the hole and disposed on another pixel electrode among the plurality of pixel electrodes.

title: Liquid metal/high polymer composite dielectric material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite materials, and particularly relates to a liquid metal/polymer composite dielectric material and a preparation method thereof. Uniformly blending the polymerization monomer solution, the liquid metal and the cross-linking agent to obtain a precursor solution; and standing the precursor solution to obtain the high-molecular dielectric material. The preparation method is simple and convenient, and the prepared composite material has excellent dielectric property and better tensile property than the traditional dielectric material, and has wide application prospect in the fields of wearable electronic equipment, soft robots and the like.

title: Preparation method and application of nano carbon material
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon material preparation, in particular to a preparation method and application of a nano carbon material. The invention provides a preparation method of a nano carbon material, which takes carbon chain polymer substances such as plastics and the like as raw materials and is prepared by three-stage microwave treatment under the action of a microwave catalyst; in the three-stage microwave treatment, the power of the first stage microwave treatment is more than or equal to 200W, the power of the second stage microwave treatment is improved by 20-40% compared with the power of the first stage microwave treatment, and the power of the third stage microwave treatment is improved by 45-65% compared with the power of the second stage microwave treatment. The preparation method has the advantages of low cost, high yield and high purity, is a safe, energy-saving, environment-friendly and efficient nano carbon material preparation process, and combustible gas rich in hydrogen, methane and other gases generated in the preparation process can be recycled, so that the resource utilization rate is greatly improved.

title: Acid anhydride compound, polyamideimide resin and film using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to an acid anhydride compound having a novel structure, a polyamideimide resin prepared therefrom, and a polyamideimide film. Specifically, since the polyamideimide film according to the present invention includes the structural unit derived from the acid anhydride compound, the polyamideimide film may be colorless and transparent, and may have high heat resistance and a low coefficient of thermal expansion.

title: Preparation method of composite material with porous coating and porous coating cloth
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a composite material with a porous coating and porous coating cloth, and relates to the technical field of porous composite materials. A method of making a composite material having a porous coating, comprising: applying the aqueous coating slurry to the surface of a substrate, drying for the first time, and soaking in water for a certain time to obtain a pre-expansion coating; the aqueous coating slurry contains 1-25% of water-absorbent resin particles by weight of the aqueous coating slurry; and removing the expanded water-absorbent resin particles in the pre-expansion coating layer, and drying for the second time to obtain the composite material with the porous coating layer. The invention can obtain composite materials with different gas bubble forms and sizes through a simple preparation method.

title: Anti-static composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an anti-static composite material (IPC classification number: C08L23/12), in particular to an anti-static composite material and a preparation method thereof. The anti-static composite material comprises a first anti-static layer, a strength enhancement layer and a second anti-static layer from top to bottom in sequence. The antistatic composite material prepared by the invention takes polyolefin, inorganic filler and coupling agent as a strength enhancement layer, takes polypropylene copolymer and conductive master batch as an antistatic layer, and has the characteristics of antistatic function and high strength; in addition, the antistatic composite material has simple preparation process, is convenient for industrial production, can be widely used in petrochemical industry, military industry, aerospace industry and IT (information electronics) industry, and has antistatic devices and tools for semiconductor, antistatic production technical equipment and products, production and life.

title: Automobile charging flap assembly and electric automobile
abstract: The invention discloses an automobile charging flap assembly and an electric automobile, and belongs to the technical field of automobiles. Through being equipped with at least one bolster on the rotor arm to when the rotor arm drives the lid and rotates, the rotor arm drives the sustainable extrusion casing of bolster rotation, when the lid was opened to the biggest angle process, last compress tightly between casing and the bolster, realize the linear absorption to the impact energy, can not shake when the lid is opened to the biggest position, and does not have more obvious striking sound, promotes the comfort that the user used.

title: Electrical contact and electrical connection device
abstract: The present invention reduces the number of components to improve conductivity, improves the sliding property of an elastic member, controls the elastic force according to the characteristics of a contact object, and improves the electrical contact stability with the contact object. The electrical contact of the present invention is formed by winding a plate-like member having conductivity, and includes: a1 st contact portion formed by winding a1 st distal end portion of the plate-like member; a1 st elastic portion formed by winding a tapered upper arm portion; a2 nd contact portion formed by winding the 2 nd distal end portion; a2 nd elastic portion formed by winding a tapered lower arm portion; and a tubular portion formed by winding the main body of the plate-like member.

title: Extension tray rotating device
abstract: The invention discloses an extension tray rotating device which comprises a shaft arranged on the tail of a box body, wherein a shaft sleeve is sleeved on the shaft, two side plates are sleeved on the shaft sleeve, the bottoms of the two side plates are provided with the same bottom plate, and the tops of the two side plates are provided with the same locking block seat plate. The tray is lengthened, fixed by using the rotary lock, can carry the shelter, has a simple structure and firm installation, and is suitable for various extension devices.

title: Power device fixing apparatus
abstract: An apparatus for fixing a power device is disclosed. According to one aspect of the present invention, a power device fixing device comprises: a body unit accommodating a power device; a coupling unit protruding from one side surface of the body unit and having a coupling space; and a cover unit fixed to the body unit and including a coupling protrusion protruding. The coupling protrusion can be inserted into the coupling space.

title: Rotation driving mechanism of air supply apparatus, air supply apparatus, and household appliance
abstract: A rotation driving mechanism of an air supply apparatus, an air supply apparatus, and a household appliance. The rotation driving mechanism of the air supply apparatus comprises: a fixed bracket; a rotary bracket, and the rotary bracket is sleeved on the fixed bracket and may rotate with respect to the fixed bracket; and a driving member, and the driving member is provided on the fixed bracket and used for driving the rotary bracket to rotate. Therefore, compared with the prior art, by means of the coordination of the fixed bracket, the rotary bracket, and the driving member, the size of the rotation driving mechanism can be reduced; after the rotation driving mechanism is mounted on the air supply apparatus, the air supply apparatus can have a better appearance.

title: Modulation circuit and wireless transceiver
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a modulation circuit and wireless receiving and transmitting equipment, which are used for reducing cost. The modulation circuit comprises a self-bias amplifying module and a source adjusting module, wherein a first power amplifying tube is arranged in the self-bias amplifying module and is used for amplifying specific signals, the source adjusting module is connected with a source electrode of the first power amplifying tube in the self-bias amplifying module, and the source adjusting module is used for adjusting the source electrode potential of the first power amplifying tube when the self-bias amplifying module is in a power-down mode so that the gate source voltage of the first power amplifying tube is lower than a threshold voltage and further the drain current of the first power amplifying tube is zero.

title: Signal processing method, apparatus and device
abstract: The embodiments of the present invention provide a signal processing method, apparatus and device, and a computer readable storage medium. Said method comprises: processing multiple types of bandwidth signals to be sent, to form multiple groups of standard bandwidth signals; filtering the multiple groups of standard bandwidth signals; and combining the filtered multiple groups of standard bandwidth signals and transmitting same. In the embodiments of the present invention, multiple types of bandwidth signals are processed to form multiple groups of standard bandwidth signals, so that a DUC/DDC can use uniform processing architecture which has high reusability and high flexible extensibility, reducing the processing complexity and design redundancy of the DUC/DDC, achieving a simpler and more consistent structure, and reducing the costs and heat consumption of a digital intermediate frequency chip.

title: Data transmission method, data receiving method, device and system
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of data transmission technologies, and in particular, to a data transmission method, a data receiving method, a device, and a system. The data transmission method is applied to host equipment and comprises the steps of determining clock frequency, wherein the clock frequency comprises a first frequency, a second frequency lower than the first frequency or/and a third frequency higher than the first frequency, and transmitting a composite signal through the change trend of the clock frequency and a transmission period, wherein the composite signal comprises a clock signal and a characteristic signal, and the clock signal and the characteristic signal are synchronously transmitted. The invention fuses the characteristic signals on the clock signals, reduces the number of data transmission interfaces in a compound mode, and improves the transmission efficiency.

title: Transmitting apparatus and operating method thereof
abstract: According to the present invention, a transmitting apparatus comprises: an antenna module; a first communication module for transmitting and receiving signals via the antenna module with a first terminal served by the transmitting apparatus; and a processor electrically coupled to the first communication module. The processor obtains a channel matrix between terminals performing receive beamforming and the transmitting apparatus, obtains, from the obtained channel matrix, a first interference channel matrix corresponding to channel matrix between terminals other than the first terminal among the terminals and the transmitting apparatus, obtains, from the obtained first interference channel matrix, a second interference channel matrix satisfying an interference intensity condition, and determines a precoding matrix for a transmit stream of the first terminal based on a given precoding matrix and the obtained second interference channel matrix. Therefore, the present invention can minimize interference strength of transmit stream of a served terminal and determine an optimal precoding matrix for the transmit stream.

title: Circuit and method for improving radio frequency isolation and mobile terminal
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a circuit, a method and a mobile terminal for improving radio frequency isolation, wherein the circuit comprises: the switch module comprises at least two isolation control modules; the isolation control module receives signals of a plurality of frequency bands and is used for outputting attenuated signals; the switch module is connected with the isolation control module and used for gating a radio frequency channel according to a received frequency band, the radio frequency channel corresponds to the isolation control module corresponding to the received frequency band and outputs the signal meeting the requirement of preset isolation. The scheme improves the radio frequency isolation, and the space which can be saved is realized by combining frequency bands according to requirements, and the more the combination is, the more the space is saved relatively.

title: Pharmaceutical composition and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a pharmaceutical composition comprising sulfated polysaccharide and a small molecule active substance, wherein the sulfated polysaccharide encapsulates the small molecule active substance. The composition can make sulfated polysaccharide and micromolecular active substances produce synergistic effect, enhance the bioactivity of the sulfated polysaccharide and micromolecular active substances, and provide support for research and development and application of novel micromolecular medicaments.

title: Pharmaceutical compositions
abstract: The invention relates to pharmaceutical compositions comprising ((((((R)-1-(6-amino-9H-purin-9-yl)propan-2-yl)oxy)methyl)(phenoxy)phosphoryl)oxy)methyl pivalate or a pharmaceutically acceptable derivative thereof, optionally with an additional agent, methods of making them, and their use in medicine.

title: Compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a compound with a structure shown in a formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, solvate, hydrate or isotope label thereof, a preparation method of the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, solvate, hydrate or isotope label thereof and application of the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, solvate, hydrate or isotope label in preparing an iron death inhibitor,

title: Antiviral compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a compound for antiviral treatment, a preparation method and application thereof. In particular to a compound shown in a formula I or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and a pharmaceutically acceptable preparation prepared from the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. The compound has better antiviral effect, and can effectively prevent and treat diseases of human beings or animals caused by infection of coronavirus, calicivirus, influenza virus, rabies virus, hepatitis B virus and the like.

title: Compound or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, pharmaceutical composition and application
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, and particularly relates to a compound shown as a formula I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof; the invention also relates to a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and application thereof; the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof can be used for preventing or treating cancers and inhibiting or killing tumor cells;

title: O-containing organic electrophosphorescent material and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescent display, and particularly discloses a novel O-containing organic electrophosphorescent material and application thereof in an organic electroluminescent device. The O-containing organic electrophosphorescent material provided by the invention has a structure shown as a general formula (I). The organic electrophosphorescent material is applied to an organic electroluminescent device, and the prepared electroluminescent device has the superior performances of high purity, high brightness and high efficiency.

title: Packaging bag as well as method for production
abstract: A packaging bag has a bag body formed from a flat web and has a first front wall and a second front wall as well as a stand-up bottom formed in a bottom section by folding and gluing the front walls. The flat web has a varnish coating on an outside of the bag body, wherein the first front wall has an adhesive region free of the varnish coating in the bottom section of the bag body.

title: Refractory filter
abstract: A refractory filter suitable for filtering molten metal, such as steel, and a method and powdered composition for producing the filter. The filter comprises refractory material, the refractory material comprising: 60-90 wt % alumina; 8-30 wt % zirconia; and 3-20 wt % magnesia. The powdered composition comprises: 60-90 wt % alumina; 8-30 wt % zirconia; and 3-20 wt % magnesia, wherein the powdered composition comprises less than 12.5 wt % reactive alumina, calcined alumina or a mixture thereof, and wherein the remainder of the alumina is tabular alumina. The method comprises: providing a powdered composition in accordance with the invention; forming a filter precursor from the powdered composition and a liquid component; and firing the filter precursor to form a refractory filter.

title: Water pump water pressure resistance sealing performance test board
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of pump test equipment, in particular to a water pressure resistance and tightness test board of a water pump, which comprises a main body mechanism, wherein the main body mechanism comprises a pedestal, the pedestal is provided with a limiting mechanism, the limiting mechanism comprises an air pump, the air pump is fixedly connected with a connector through an air duct, and a propping mechanism is arranged in the connector. In the invention, when the air pump fills air into the water pump to form pressure, a part of air enters the air passage, and then the high-pressure air pushes the piston disc to drive the push-pull rod to move, and when the push-pull rod drives the sliding block to move, the push-pull rod drives the push-pull rod to drive the push-pull block to push the water outlet of the water pump upwards, so that the water outlet of the water pump is in further tight contact with the sealing sleeve, gas leakage is prevented, and the test effect is influenced. Meanwhile, the sealing sleeve and the joint are in a truncated cone-shaped design, so that water outlets of water pumps with various specifications can be met, and the abutting rod and the abutting block slide along with the sliding block, so that the water outlets of the water pumps with various specifications can be extruded, and the tightness is ensured.

title: Plastic tray for classification
abstract: The utility model discloses a plastic tray for classification, which comprises an annular plate and a base, wherein a plurality of cavities are formed in the annular plate, the cavities are circumferentially distributed by taking the axial direction of the annular plate as the center, storage box components are arranged in the cavities, a fixed column is rotationally arranged on the base and is fixed with the annular plate through a connecting frame, and a moving mechanism is arranged on the fixed column and is used for simultaneously moving the storage box components. The beneficial effects are that: through setting up a plurality of storing box subassemblies and be used for placing different components and parts to the storing box subassembly all concentrates the setting on the annular plate, is convenient for look for and take the use to the components and parts, through rotatory annular plate, rotates corresponding storing box subassembly before the staff to the staff puts in the part, all removes the cavity with whole storing box subassembly through moving mechanism in, seals the storing box subassembly through the cavity, can avoid components and parts to spill in the storing box subassembly like this.
